author: Mairead Dorney
content: Excellent service. The party we held was a huge success. The children LOVED all the play equipment, they really had a ball. I thought that you at Dancing Cubs were highly professional from beginning to end. Your staff who delivered the play equipment were prompt, polite and pleasant to deal with and all the play equipment was very clean. Overall we were delighted. I will definitely be recommending your company to my friends for future events.
